description: fz2 run/interp/build reject any arg after the source path (parse_source_options, src/compiler2/cli.rs:581-599). Add `fz2 run|interp <file> -- args...`; the AOT executable's C main(argc, argv) (src/ir_codegen/backend.rs:323-331, src/ir_codegen/aot_main.rs) passes its own argv. No process-global argv exists; per-driver ExecCtx (runtime/src/exec_ctx.rs) is the shared seam. Returns a list of binaries, as Elixir.
title: System.argv/0 on all three paths
